verdict.rationale: An official CLI is a fair question for a government tax and licensing service, since such an agency could ship command-line tooling for filing or lookups, so the axis applies. The evidence describes only web-based My DOR filing, Express File, mail applications and a phone line. It mentions no official CLI, and probes for llms.txt, markdown docs and OpenAPI specs all returned 404, so there is no evidence of programmatic tooling of any kind.
